reasoning: On the season so far the Cavaliers are the stronger team; with home court the Cavaliers start about 3 points better, in a game of about 245 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Cavaliers.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bulls (confidence, revenge).
Bottom line: the Cavaliers win 62 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 219 and 268 total points.
